prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity north-star desktop web portfolio comp, first viewport, landscape 16:9
Primary request: Design Costa Maskulov's bilingual creative full-stack developer portfolio as an "Atlas of Systems": an interactive celestial chart where projects, skills and decisions form a navigable technical constellation.
Structure: unmistakably a production website interface. Slim top navigation: Costa Maskulov, Projets, À propos, FR / EN. The hero is a deep near-black chart field with a monumental readable headline, coordinate rules and magnitude-scaled nodes. SideQuest is the brightest mapped object, visibly labeled "mock fictif — application non réalisée", connected to smaller nodes for UX, Frontend, Backend, Accessibilité. Include a clear lime action to open projects and a secondary about action. Show a compact indexed legend and enough next-section content at the fold.
Visual system: sophisticated star-atlas grammar, coordinate grid, cream labels, violet spatial field, lime active target, pink editorial annotation. No literal outer-space photography; the map is a precise interactive data graphic.
Typography: monumental condensed display for Costa and the headline, readable sans-serif for all controls and data, restrained italic serif for constellation names only.
Text (verbatim): "COSTA MASKULOV"; "DÉVELOPPEUR FULL-STACK CRÉATIF"; "CARTOGRAPHIER DES EXPÉRIENCES WEB SINGULIÈRES"; "VOIR LES PROJETS"; "À PROPOS"; "SIDEQUEST"; "MOCK FICTIF — APPLICATION NON RÉALISÉE"; "UX"; "FRONTEND"; "BACKEND"; "ACCESSIBILITÉ"; "FR / EN".
Color palette: #101113 #F5F1E8 #4B3CFF #C7FF00 #FF6BD6.
Constraints: visitor must understand immediately this is a developer portfolio, not an astronomy app. SideQuest must clearly be a fictitious project. Strong accessible contrast, clear navigation and CTA, no fake claims.
Avoid: generic cyberpunk, galaxy photo, sci-fi game HUD overload, gradients, glassmorphism, tiny unreadable data, device mockup, poster-only layout, watermark.
